setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (4 reviews): Long, involved Dark Star, nearly as epic as 4/29/72 and possibly a top-five version of 1973; Reviewer praises Kreutzmann's drumming in Dark Star, with Jerry and Phil also strong [6][7][8][9]
- **Eyes Of The World** (2 reviews): Dark Star flows into an Eyes that is herky-jerky yet very high in energy; Eyes is a little sloppy, but the risks taken are worth it [6][8]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-06-24.sbd.miller.99852.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 27 songs; 194 min; rated 3.33/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Mix is messy early, improves midway through They Love Each Other, sounds good during Box of Rain, and is fine by Dark Star; The first few tracks of this transfer are a mess [1][12]
- **gd73-06-24.sbd.cotsman.12828.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 108 min; rated 4.12/5 by 8 [2]
- **gd1973-06-24.pset2.sbd.176.hamilton.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 3 songs; 49 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [3]

## Around the show

- Reviewer notes the Dark Star > Eyes > China Doll block is second-set material, preceded by Promised Land opener; show ends with Sugar Magnolia and Saturday Night [5]
- Encore was Johnny B. Goode, and the second set included Not Fade Away and Goin' Down The Road Feelin' Bad [2]
- Reviewer ranks this as the second true highlight of 1973 so far, after the 2/19/73 show [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-06-24.sbd.miller.99852.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel [1]. Also: Made from discs supplied by Matt Smith; all disc changes are seamless [1]
- **gd73-06-24.sbd.cotsman.12828.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: This copy is incomplete: Mexicali Blues, They Love Each Other, Looks Like Rain and Box of Rain are missing between Half Step and Around and Around; Set one is a degraded soundboard of unknown analog generations; set two came via a different chain, edited and encoded by JCotsman [2][5]
- **gd1973-06-24.pset2.sbd.176.hamilton.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Greg Hamilton; source: MSBDR > 1 cassette gen > CD > EAC > SHN [3]

## Art and photos

- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 1973-06-24 Portland PNW7374 | Cai…](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/31211412088/) [17]
- Photo by a Flickr member (All rights reserved): [Grateful Dead - 1973-06-24 Portland PNW7374 f2b | Caine Schneider | Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/44173410095/) [18]
- Photo by uncredited: [the page](https://www.flickr.com/photos/104729480@N03/31211412088/) [19]
